newsitem.title: USA: US customs seizes cocaine in tanker in NY Harbor.
newsitem.headline: US customs seizes cocaine in tanker in NY Harbor.

text.p: Undercover agents raided an oil tanker in New York Harbour late on Wednesday, seizing millions of dollars worth of cocaine, a U.S. Customs spokesman said on Thursday.

Two stowaways were arrested on the tanker Centaurus Mar and the Coast Guard said it was still searching by boat and helicopter for one or two other people who may have jumped overboard during the raid.

Customs spokesman Derek Farthing said agents recovered 95 pounds (43 kg) of cocaine from the ship, which was bound for Bayonne, New Jersey, from Colombia. The cocaine had an estimated value of $1.7 million.

Agents at the scene off Staten Island in New York Harbour said some of the suspects panicked and started throwing packages of cocaine into the water when the agents boarded. Most of the cocaine was seized in the rudder compartment of the tanker, officials said.
The stowaways used wet suits and hammocks while they were hiding in the rudder.
